operations.title: Entry 766 — The Complete Hom Defect Has a Cyclic Orbit
operations.locator: src/ledger/20260818-766 The Complete Hom Defect Has a Cyclic Orbit.md

operations.title: Cyclic transport of complete Hom extension, pole lattice, and infinity shear

operations.outcome: The complete filtered Hom splitting complex transports through the three independent residue gauges with zero frame, pole-lattice, or threefold-return failures at 24 generic points. The rank-one defect is constant in the recursively transported adapted frame; the degree-six infinity shear is transported as a lattice and returns after three charts.

evidence.paraphrase: Transported adapted gauges and threefold frame/pole cycles have zero failures.
